capabilities: five-component episodic semantic procedural working identity artifact envelope
Merkle-DAG parent integrity and cycle rejection
scoped capability tokens with audience expiration and permissions
canonical projection digest for replay and audit

research_inputs.finding: Portable Agent Memory proposes a five-component memory model, Merkle-DAG provenance, capability-scoped access, and injection-resistant rehydration.
research_inputs.used_for: provider-neutral artifact format, signed provenance, capability filtering, and data-only framing

research_inputs.finding: The Agent-Memory Protocol emphasizes deterministic redact-at-rest, pack-for-purpose, and hydrate-on-return operations to protect sensitive memory.
research_inputs.used_for: purpose-bounded rehydration and explicit privacy/security boundary; full PII redaction remains a future bounded service

research_inputs.finding: AgentMemBench evaluates memory strategies using recall, ranking, faithfulness, footprint, and latency, exposing an accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
research_inputs.used_for: including a local footprint/latency benchmark and refusing unsupported end-to-end memory-quality claims

research_inputs.finding: OpenShell uses sandbox, filesystem, network, process, and inference policy layers for autonomous agents.
research_inputs.used_for: keeping portable-memory rehydration separate from execution and preserving capability/policy boundaries

limitations: This is a bounded user-space portable-memory contract and does not replace the existing durable memory journals.
The implementation uses SHA-256 for standard-library portability; it does not claim BLAKE3 compatibility with any external protocol.
Ed25519 trust roots are supplied by the caller; no TPM, HSM, KMS, or external operator ceremony is implied.
Rehydration frames content as data but does not guarantee model-level prompt-injection immunity.
The benchmark is local control-plane overhead, not retrieval quality, model accuracy, storage latency, or production cost.
This upgrade does not claim AGI, learning, model retraining, physical hardware qualification, or production approval.
